這首來自野巢Yen 在這三年的時光轉移中，默默地在不同時間點從2024年的suly 一次來訪倫敦寫下這首音樂、2025年再度回到倫敦學校的Yen 遇見 Oscar Brady,到當時遇見的新朋友仲雲，我們和仲雲寫下的第一首音樂就是Overground, 這首音樂野巢也默默地想傳達新的視角，這樣的音樂默默地再讓我們重新建立世界觀，在這些緣分之中不想退縮，想和這個世界交朋友，其中這次和一起同在英國生活的插畫家Bibi 把野巢的經歷從他的眼中 recreate 到新的世界裡，我們也正在期待這一串音樂的作品將會怎麼和這些 Bibi 眼中的我們互動，同時一起成長； Overgorund 也是來自英國的其中一部地鐵，Bibi 也正想像大家正在穿越鐵軌一起行動看看的樣子。

description:
My Christmas Homecoming Song for Mom This year I made several Christmas songs, but I still haven’t prepared one for my family. It’s been brewing for a long time. I’m gonna sing a Christmas Homecoming Song for Mom. I want to use my mother’s mother tongue to sing my true self. I didn’t grow up speaking Taiwanese; my childhood was in Mandarin. Mom knows I usually sing in English, French, and Mandarin—she’s heard some of them. So when I decided to write a Taiwanese song for her, I felt a little uneasy. Not because I was afraid I couldn’t sing it well, but because I don’t usually speak Taiwanese with her. Of course, anyone who knows me would know that making this song would definitely require Minzer’s help—at least with the Taiwanese and the music theory. I can understand and speak it, but turning what I wanted to say into proper singable Taiwanese, and making that bit of French swing land right on the spoiling, playful feel, wasn’t something I could do alone. I still needed AI to help turn the lyrics into Taiwanese characters and Tai-lo romanization first, then worked on them with Minzer. There are a few words I’m not entirely sure I pronounced correctly when I recorded them; I just went by feel. But I know Mom will understand. She’ll listen to the end, then correct me in her Taichung accent: “Silly child, that’s not how you say those words. Where we’re from, it’s…” I hesitated over the style for a while. Folk felt too proper, Nakashi too noisy, a straight ballad too solemn. In the end I chose a touch of French jazz swing. Not because it’s fancy, but because the rhythm has a gentle sway to it—a little lazy, a little spoiled. Like when I was little, sitting beside her and saying unnecessary things just to make her look at me a bit longer. No need to lock the door. The suitcase stays under the table for now. She asks how long I’m staying this time. I say, tomorrow. We’ll see. There’s no big message. This time I just want to use her mother tongue to sing the version of me that still acts spoiled with her, that still isn’t in a hurry to leave. I know I might start crying while singing and not be able to continue. Please, no. I’ll practice a little, just in case. It’ll probably happen on a line I think I’ve already got down. The more familiar the part, the more likely I am to get stuck. I’ll be watching her face while she listens. Part of me wants her to cry, but I also can’t bear it. It probably won’t be because the lyrics are so moving, but because of my clumsy, unpracticed Taiwanese—making her want to hug this son of hers who’s not so young anymore, not so light anymore, already has a salt-and-pepper beard. A big middle-aged son. Hard to hug. Then she’ll correct my pronunciation and serve me another bowl of rice. Even though I know Mom uses AI translation, there are just some things I can’t bring myself to say directly in Mandarin, not to mention Taiwanese. So I decided to write this in English.

description:
總是有些時候，就是不知道怎麼了，什麼都不太對勁。連自己的歌也越聽越可疑。問人家唱得怎樣，人家說「很好」，敏哲聽成「還好」。同一段錄音放了好幾遍，他才忽然想，算了，我根本在鑽牛角尖。歌先擱著，出去動一動也好。 等那陣情緒過去，敏哲回頭把這段經歷寫成一首關於創作焦慮的歌。他想起自己以前寫過〈很好〉，忍不住苦笑。本來什麼都很好，今天怎麼只剩還好？笑完又有點得意，索性在編曲和唱腔裡，把一句「還好」唱出幾種意思。 兩首歌很難說誰比較好。〈很好〉大概是個花昏癡漢，〈還好〉則是諮商間的哲學生。哲學生好像有深度一點。至少他自己是這麼覺得的。 =============== 音樂的兩面性 同一組旋律，可以把它唱成「很好」也可以唱成「還好（呃，其實並不太好）」 都好，音樂可以擺平我不同的情緒。 很好： https://streetvoice.com/minzer_c_lee/songs/880827/

lyrics:
I had a dream of a faraway, southern isle… A thousand miles, maybe just one. Golden sand, I close my eyes, Wake up lost in a strange paradise. Wrapped in white, sunflowers bright, Dark-eyed strangers, staring in light. They take my hand, lead me inside, Cool winds dance where the fabrics glide. Sing me a song, play me a tune, A missing string, still hums in the room. Swaying slow, I hear the past, Echoes of friends I thought wouldn’t last. Fruits so big, colors so new, Birds sing songs the sky never knew. They pour me a drink, sweet and deep, Smile so wide, my soul sinks deep. The night fades out, the stars burn bright, Lost in mist, lost in time. Drifting, floating, under the moon, Felt like morning came too soon. 我曾做過一場夢，夢見遙遠的南方小島…… 也許相隔千里，也許近在咫尺。 金色的沙灘，我輕輕閉上雙眼， 醒來時，卻置身陌生的天堂。 一身白衣，映著燦爛的向日葵， 一雙雙深邃的眼眸，在陽光下凝望著我。 他們牽起我的手，帶我走進屋裡， 清涼的微風，穿梭在輕柔飄動的布幔之間。 為我唱首歌，為我奏一段旋律， 即使少了一根弦，房間裡依然迴盪著樂音。 我隨著節奏，緩緩搖曳， 聽見了過去的回聲， 那些我曾以為，再也無法相見的朋友。 碩大的果實，從未見過的繽紛色彩， 鳥兒唱著，連天空都未曾聽過的歌。 他們為我斟上一杯飲品，甜美而深沉， 那燦爛的笑容，讓我的靈魂漸漸沉醉。 夜色悄然褪去，繁星卻依然閃耀， 迷失在薄霧之中，迷失在時間的縫隙裡。 在月光下，漂浮著，徜徉著， 總覺得，清晨來得太早了。

description:
Sound Hacker 創作營 期6 Co-write : 翊嘉、子豪、Selvia、Sarah 《Love Story Is Not Romantic》是一首以失戀與情感記憶為核心的作品，描寫一段長達兩年的親密關係結束後，面對習慣、回憶與自我重新建立的過程。 歌曲前段以憂傷且帶有敘事感的旋律展開，透過直白的歌詞與情緒鋪陳，呈現對過往關係的不捨，以及那些即使已經離開，卻仍反覆浮現的聲音與片段。中段則轉換為輕快的 Bossa Nova 節奏，以相對慵懶、輕盈的音樂語彙，重新詮釋忘不掉的感情。這種音樂情緒與歌詞內容之間的反差，讓原本沉重的思念多了一份自嘲與灑脫。 後段進一步轉向 Freestyle 與 Rap-singing 的表現形式，搭配鋼琴獨奏，讓情緒從原先的敘事逐漸轉化為更自由、直接的內心對話，也為整首歌的故事收尾。 這不只是一首關於失去某個人的歌，更是一段關於如何與過去共存、重新找回自己的過程。因為有些 Love Story，從來就不如想像中浪漫。
